tiers.tier: Tier 1 — High-Risk Interactive, Focus & Accent Surfaces

tiers.tier: Tier 2 — Component Isolation, Content Stress & Zoom Resilience
tiers.scope: All 117 renderable visual components (`components/lifecycle.json`), 21 `.card.html` boards, 96 Atomic View stories
tiers.coverage: Rendered in Light (EN) & Dark (VI) at 1280px, narrow 320px mobile overflow sweep across all 21 component cards, plus 200% root font-size scaling (`WCAG 1.4.4`) and `matte-paper` dark stress probe.

tiers.tier: Tier 3 — Complete Product Shells, UI Kits & Screen Templates
tiers.scope: 15 complete pages + 6 product-screen `.dc.html` templates + 2 composite specimens
tiers.coverage: Rendered and measured at 1280x820 (Light EN + Dark VI), 909x540 (Pixel CI baseline frame), 390x844 mobile, and 320x568 ultra-narrow stress across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

tiers.tier: Tier 4 — Print, Legal A4, Letter, Deck & Email Templates
tiers.scope: 79 document/deck/email `.dc.html` templates (38 VN A4 legal instruments, 21 Letter docs, 7 emails, 4 decks, 9 reference/social)
tiers.coverage: Every single template rendered at 1280x820 and 390x844 with automated overflow, clipping, console/pageerror, and CTA contrast verification; representative archetypes (`bod-report`, `vn-labor-contract`, `delivery-kickoff`, `tech-incident-report`, `slide-deck`, `email`) additionally raster-checked in Pixel CI.

disclosedCoverageGaps: Non-neutral element packs (`hoa`, `thuy`, `moc`, `kim`) combined simultaneously with `200%` text zoom on print-only A4 `.dc.html` legal templates were not individually screenshotted (print instruments use fixed ink-on-paper semantics).

Assistive technology verification is structural/programmatic (ARIA roles, keyboard focus, contrast); live human screen-reader listening (VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS) and physical iOS/Android touch hardware remain manual acceptance items.
External document host pipelines (Microsoft Word desktop rendering, PowerPoint PPTX export, third-party email client engines) are outside repository browser runtime scope per `docs/doctrine.md`.
Local macOS/Docker Chromium rasterization approximates but does not replace GitHub Actions `ubuntu-latest` font rasterization for final CI baseline sign-off (`_audit/baselines/README.md`).

items.name: Primitive & Semantic Colors
items.applicableVariantsAndStates: Light & Dark themes; Standard & High contrast (`data-cs-contrast="high"` / `prefers-contrast: more`); Brand anchors (#45210E Umber, #F4BA17 Ochre), surfaces, inks, borders, 4 semantic status ramps (success, warning, danger, info).

findings.summary: Light --cs-color-text-muted (#3F2D21, OKLCH L=0.3121) sat within DeltaL=0.0445 of --cs-color-text-primary (#45210E, L=0.2676), compressing primary-vs-secondary ink hierarchy.

--cs-color-border-default (#E7D9C6, 1.24:1 vs #FFFFFF panel) is tuned for calm container hairlines while --cs-component-textfield-border-default (#BFA58F, 2.33:1) anchors interactive inputs; 11 Wave-2/3 form pickers mistakenly bound container border instead of input border.

changes: Lightened Light --cs-color-text-muted in tokens/colors.css from #3F2D21 to #5E4436 (OKLCH L=0.412, C=0.042, H=48deg; 5.6x larger lightness separation from #45210E while clearing APCA Lc >= 77 on neutral, soft, and middle surfaces) and bound per-pack --_cs-light-color-text-muted / --_cs-dark-color-text-muted channels in scripts/generate-element-packs.mjs + scripts/lib/theme-resolver.mjs so deep element packs preserve APCA Lc >= 75 across all 55,080 body-text rows.
Rebound 11 interactive peer controls in base/forms.css, base/controls.css, and base/ai.css to --cs-component-textfield-border-default (#BFA58F, 2.33:1).
Synchronized a01-theme-mirrors/colors.css, theme-colocated.json, and all 256 DTCG/native mode packs.

verification.visualAssessment: Verified in isolated foundation specimens and composed product/component surfaces across Light/Dark and EN/VI.

items.name: Typography Families, Scale, Line-Height & Tracking

verification.visualAssessment: Verified in isolated foundation specimens and composed product/component surfaces across Light/Dark and EN/VI.
